name: How much does a pool remodel cost in Los Angeles if I only replace tile and coping?

mainEntity.name: How much does a pool remodel cost in Los Angeles if I only replace tile and coping?
mainEntity.text: How much does a pool remodel cost in Los Angeles if I only replace tile and coping?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tile-and-coping-only remodel is one of the most common middle-tier pool upgrades in Los Angeles. It usually costs more than a simple replaster because it includes demolition, prep, waterproofing details, new tile, new coping, and cleanup. The exact price depends on the pool perimeter, whether the existing coping can be salvaged, and whether hidden damage appears after demolition starts. Homeowners should ask whether the quote includes removal and disposal, surface prep, bond coat, waterproofing at the waterline, and trim details around steps or spas. If the pool has settling cracks, hollow coping, or old waterproofing failures, the project can grow quickly. Material choice also matters: natural stone, porcelain, and precast coping have very different labor and installation requirements. For luxury remodels, tile and coping are often the visible part of a larger scope that may also include lighting, plaster, equipment, or deck work. A detailed in-person estimate is the best way to avoid surprise change orders once demolition begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tile-and-coping-only pool remodel in Los Angeles usually costs less than a full renovation but more than basic resurfacing. Pricing depends on pool size, demolition, waterproofing, material choice, and any damage found under the existing finish. Expect the final number to rise if the coping is cracked, the tile line is failing, or the shell needs repair.
